rap.gallery.orange.prompt: A warm orange cyclorama extends seamlessly onto the floor, with soft editorial lighting and natural skin texture. A hanging vintage microphone stays clear of faces; relaxed streetwear suits each performer. A frontal medium shot holds all performers with a slow push-in. Natural shoulder bounces, light side steps and open hand gestures. Bright original hip-hop with tight kick drums, claps and short bass notes.
rap.gallery.street.prompt: A small underground cypher stage beside a graffiti brick wall at night, with teal spotlights, light haze and speakers. A small crowd gathers behind and to the sides of the stage, nodding, raising hands and gently swaying to the beat for an energetic underground live atmosphere. The audience stays softly out of focus and leaves room for the main performers, who remain clear and prominent. A low medium-wide shot keeps every main performer visible with subtle, steady handheld movement. The main performers hold wireless microphones, use grounded knee bounces and natural downward hand accents, and keep their positions. Original boom-bap with heavy kicks, crisp snares and strong bass, conveying confident street energy.
rap.gallery.neon.prompt: A late-night studio with cyan and magenta lights, a glowing mixing desk and abstract city lights, retaining natural skin tones. Performers sit on separate stable studio chairs, with microphones beside their faces. A medium shot slowly pushes in while keeping all performers visible. Small nods, rhythmic upper-body movement and restrained, readable hand gestures. Original half-time trap, deep 808s and sparse synths create a cinematic rap music-video mood.
rap.gallery.funny.prompt: A warm retro recording studio with wooden acoustic walls, record shelves, amber lamps and soft lighting. Seated performers rap with a deliberately serious attitude, using raised eyebrows, shrugs, open palms and lyrics for gentle comic contrast. Preserve the customers' actual ages, hair and appearance; do not copy the example characters or add grey hair and wrinkles. A steady frontal medium shot keeps everyone visible. Original funk hip-hop, bouncy bass, clean claps and electric piano, without canned laughter.
rap.prompt.with_photos: Main performers: use the main subjects in the uploaded photos. Preserve each person's facial features, skin tone, age, hairstyle and distinguishing features. Preserve the main people in a group photo too; the number of photos is not the number of people. Bring subjects from both photos together as main performers when two are supplied, without merging, omitting or duplicating identities. Add original background audience members only when the stage description calls for them, with appearances distinct from the main performers. Do not use the style example as an identity reference for the main performers.
rap.prompt.without_photos: People: create original fictional performers appropriate to the song content. Do not imitate a specific real artist or copy the people in the style examples.
rap.prompt.default_song: Perform all six English lines below exactly as written, in order, without translation, rewriting, omissions or extra lyrics. Use 4/4 at 120 BPM: six bars of two seconds each, one line per bar, for 12 seconds in total. Start on the first beat and finish the last line by about 11.75 seconds, with the release inside the remaining time. Slashes mark flow groups; do not speak them, these instructions or any line labels. Let the movement follow the selected stage and the rap naturally. Lyrics:
rap.prompt.customer_song: Follow the customer's content: perform supplied lyrics as lyrics, or turn supplied names, stories or ideas into a short original rhyming rap. The occasion provides context and must not override the customer's specific content. Retain names and key details; do not invent names, ages, brands or personal history. Use the language explicitly requested by the customer, otherwise follow the language of their content; use English when only an occasion is selected. Do not sing scene descriptions, field labels or these instructions.
rap.prompt.format: Output: {duration} seconds in total, {ratio} framing. Fit the vocal passage and actions within that duration, start on the beat and finish naturally inside the clip. Do not add an extra intro or outro.
rap.prompt.performance: Performance: original accompaniment and natural synthetic vocals, with clear vocals ahead of the backing track. One main performer raps solo; multiple main performers take turns naturally while the other main performers nod along. If the scene includes an audience, they react to the performance without joining the lead vocals. Keep the main performers' identities and positions continuous, hands clear of faces and lip movements aligned with the vocals. Do not read instructions or add subtitles, logos or watermarks. Photos provide appearance references, not a reconstruction of anyone's real voice.
rap.prompt.freestyle_song: Create and perform an original rap inspired by the selected stage, musical style and occasion. Choose the lyrics, rhyme, flow, tempo and line count freely to fit the selected duration; let the gestures follow the music naturally. When no occasion is supplied, choose a fitting theme from the scene and style. Follow any explicit language request in the custom scene or context; otherwise use English. Do not sing scene descriptions or these instructions.
